_manifest_rule.shareable_emission_gate: A field must not be emitted into a shareable artifact unless BOTH conditions are met: (1) shareable_safe is true, AND (2) human_review_required is false OR an explicit recorded human approval exists for this field in this record. shareable_safe alone does not function as publishing clearance.

loop.semantic_loop_label.notes: Human review completed. Neutral phrasing confirmed. Safe for third-party distribution.

loop.participants.notes: human_review_required set to true. Real first names combined with semantic labels and event excerpts may be identifying. Must not appear in any artifact destined for a third party without explicit consent from both participants. See integrity_audit.md FLAG-02, H-03.

loop.core_topic.notes: Human review completed. Contested framing removed. Safe for third-party distribution.

events.source.minimal_redacted_excerpt.notes: Contains raw statements and potentially swearing/vulnerability. Not viz_safe unless privacy_level changes to shareable_paraphrase.

events.evidence_integrity.requires_audio.notes: Must block shareable artifact generation if true.

events.observation.need_or_boundary.notes: Dependent on precise wording and constraint. Does not cover sub-fields independently — see events.observation.need_or_boundary.uncertainty_note for that sub-field's separate classification.

events.observation.need_or_boundary.unce.notes: Separately classified sub-field. Contains interpretive framing that goes beyond observation. Must not be rendered in any shareable artifact even when the parent need_or_boundary object is otherwise shareable. See integrity_audit.md FLAG-04, H-06.

events.interpretation.interpretation_tag.notes: Optional interpretations. High risk of interpretive leakage; keep private unless explicitly approved.
